strategy.thesis: Music IP investment/management firm — acquires, invests in and manages music copyrights (songwriting/master rights), generating royalty income via remakes, sync, season/issue-based revival and SNS. Asia's largest single-owner music-IP manager, backed by PE firm Praxis Capital Partners.

application.how_to_apply: Catalog/IP acquisition inquiries via beyondmusic.io.

summary.en: Seoul music-IP investment/management firm founded April 2021 by composer Park Geun-tae and ex-Mafia Company founder Lee Jang-won, backed by PE firm Praxis Capital Partners (cumulative ~₩500B invested). It acquires, invests in and manages music copyrights — Asia's largest single-owner music-IP catalog — monetizing via royalties, remakes and sync. An IP-asset investor rather than a startup-equity VC.
summary.local: 2021년 4월 작곡가 박근태와 마피아컴퍼니 창업자 출신 이장원 대표가 설립한 서울 음원 IP 투자·운용사로, PEF 프랙시스캐피탈파트너스가 누적 약 5000억원 투자. 음원 저작권을 인수·투자·관리하는 아시아 최대 단일 음원 IP 운용사로 저작권료·리메이크·싱크로 수익화. 스타트업 지분 VC라기보다 IP 자산 투자자.
